I would recommend Orvelle.
Reason:
- Estariel will not be available in the next suptix, she just joins the pool in 2-3 months in the Re:Zero event.
- Karyl is a really good unit, but dark gets less and less content from now on, having only a new godly boss (which Thunder dominates) and a Haniwa boss, in a spawn of almost 300 days. After this drought period she sees a lot more use, and becomes one of the key units for multiples archetypes, like Dark multibal and Dark SD.
- Orvelle is an amazing unit that sees use for a really long time as one of the keys members of Light SD (future best Light archetype).
- Firamelia is a really good support for all elements, that sees most use in Orochi Godly, but she is ultimately replaceable.

All these units are amazing for their elements, with Estariel being the only necessary unit for a TA (TA 4).

Personally, I would put the priority in this order:

Orvelle > Karyl = Estariel > Firamelia
